name: Auto Create Invoice on SHA Claim Submit
script:
# Only run when essential fields are present and no invoice is linked yet
if not doc.sales_invoice and doc.patient_name and doc.service_type and doc.amount_claimed:

    item_map = {
        "Outpatient": "SHA Outpatient Service",
        "Inpatient": "SHA Inpatient Service",
        "Maternity": "SHA Maternity Service",
        "Laboratory": "SHA Laboratory Service",
        "Pharmacy": "SHA Pharmacy Service",
    }
    item_code = item_map.get(doc.service_type)

    if not item_code:
        frappe.msgprint("No item mapped for service type: " + str(doc.service_type))
    elif not frappe.db.exists("Item", item_code):
        frappe.msgprint("Item not found: " + item_code)
    else:
        si = frappe.new_doc("Sales Invoice")
        si.customer = "SHA"
        si.posting_date = doc.date_of_service or frappe.utils.today()
        si.due_date = frappe.utils.add_days(si.posting_date, 30)
        si.append("items", {
            "item_code": item_code,
            "qty": 1,
            "rate": frappe.utils.flt(doc.amount_claimed),
        })
        si.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
        si.submit()

        frappe.db.set_value("SHA Claim", doc.name, "sales_invoice", si.name)
        frappe.msgprint("Sales Invoice " + si.name + " created and linked.")

name: Write Off Rejected SHA Claims
script:
if doc.rejected_amount and doc.rejected_amount > 0 and not doc.writeoff_journal_entry and doc.sales_invoice:

    je = frappe.new_doc("Journal Entry")
    je.voucher_type = "Journal Entry"
    je.company = "St. Scholastica Uzima Hospital"
    je.posting_date = doc.date_of_service or frappe.utils.today()
    je.user_remark = "Write-off of rejected SHA claim " + doc.name

    je.append("accounts", {
        "account": "Claim Rejection Write-off - SSUH",
        "debit_in_account_currency": frappe.utils.flt(doc.rejected_amount),
    })
    je.append("accounts", {
        "account": "SHA Receivable - SSUH",
        "credit_in_account_currency": frappe.utils.flt(doc.rejected_amount),
        "party_type": "Customer",
        "party": "SHA",
    })

    je.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
    je.submit()

    frappe.db.set_value("SHA Claim", doc.name, "writeoff_journal_entry", je.name)
    frappe.msgprint("Write-off Journal Entry " + je.name + " created.")
